messages:
maya: quick UX pulse  noticed users overlook the autoscale "mini" controls in the new dense table. they scan rows and never see burst or the SLO knob.

ravi: yep saw same in usability test. suggestion: make an inline affordance that hints there's more without expanding full card.

anya: what if we use a compact icon/button 'Capacity' with a small disclosure arrow, not full text. clicking opens an inline flyout with exact controls.

gabe: ok but label needs to communicate burst vs baseline. 'Capacity' is vague.

maya: alternative: 'Capacity  Burst' pill (very small text). on focus it opens flyout. this keeps rows compact but signals both features.

designbot: attached mock: https://redwood.design/mocks/1758234567/mini-capacity-flyout.png (includes keyboard overlay + aria notes)

ravi: accessibility: flyout must be reachable via keyboard and screen readers. add role="button" + aria-expanded on the pill; flyout elements need aria-labelledby.

anya: copy notes: use "Burst capacity" label inside flyout and tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs for short spikes. Billed separately." short and action-oriented.

gabe: SLO naming: testers misunderstood 'SLO'. Use 'Target latency (p95)' with a small help icon linking to docs.

maya: good. also add a tiny numeric input next to slider and +/- step buttons for keyboard users.

qa-bot: test checklist idea: verify pill is tabbable, Enter/Space opens flyout, slider keyboard steps (1 by arrow, 10 by page), numeric input syncs with slider, and pool suggestion appears when min > pool.

ravi: behavior question: when min > current pool capacity, show inline warning + 'Find pools with capacity' CTA that opens the picker filtered by headroom.

anya: yes, don't auto-switch. make the CTA lightweight and preserve user's current selection.

designbot: updated figma with error state screens and the picker filter mock: https://redwood.design/files/1758234567/flyout-error-picker.png

maya: handoff checklist for eng: 1) compact pill affordance; 2) keyboard/screen-reader support; 3) flyout with numeric inputs + steppers; 4) copy: 'Burst capacity' and 'Target latency (p95)'; 5) inline warning + filtered picker; 6) QA checklist attached; 7) analytics events: flyout_opened, burst_set, slo_updated, suggest_picker_clicked.

gabe: also log fallback events if headroom calc times out.

ravi: i'll open INF-2191 with acceptance criteria and attach mocks + aria export.

maya: thanks all. jen, can you own localization strings? (cc @jen)

designbot: exported strings: https://redwood.design/strings/1758234567/mini-capacity-strings.json

maya: closing thread. please add any follow-ups here. :raised_hands:
